# Business Analysis

Approved requirement spaces, one hub link per space plus its foundation
docs and domain overviews. The business analyst curates this map in the
same session that creates or retires a space or domain; leaves get
their edges from their node overviews and nav sections.

No spaces yet. The business-analysis entry adds the first row.
